messages:
Lina Chen: Quick travel-expense Q — we did a 6-day cross-border road trip (FR/DE/CH). Rental was on company card, but fuel, tolls, parking, ferry were paid in cash in EUR/CHF. Some toll machines didn’t print receipts. Also one teammate prepaid a group ferry ticket and wants to split. Should we file actuals or use per-diem? cc @people-ops
Maya (People Ops): TL;DR: file actuals for fuel/tolls/parking; convert to USD; attach receipts. Per-diem only covers meals (prorated on travel days). If receipt missing: use lost-receipt form for amounts under $25, >$25 needs manager sign + bank/cc statement. Policy link: https://intranet.redwood/expenses (see "International & cash receipts").
Miguel (Finance): For currency conversions we use the daily midpoint rate from our FX provider on the transaction date. If you paid by card, attach the card statement line instead of a currency convert screenshot. For CHF specifically, include the merchant name and date — bank feed often shows CHF->USD already.
Jordan Patel: Any special rules for VAT reclaim? Rental and fuel in Switzerland vs EU — wondering if it's worth reclaiming.
Maya (People Ops): VAT reclaim only when vendor issues an invoice in the company name and local VAT refund is supported. Switzerland is different: often no reclaim for fuel, rental invoices may be reclaimable if they include VAT and company details. File the expense and flag "VAT reclaim"; OPS can follow up with Finance for large amounts.
ExpenseBot: Reminder :receipt: Required receipt fields: date, merchant, amount, currency. Missing receipt threshold = $25. Attach photos as JPEG/PNG or PDF.
Maya (People Ops): For split expenses (one person pays for multiple folks), create a single expense item for the full charge, add an "Attendees / Split" note listing names and per-person amounts, and upload the original receipt. Example description field:
```
Expense: Ferry (Group) — 6 pax
Original payer: Jordan Patel
Split: Jordan 0.00, Lina 45.00, Maya 45.00, Sam 45.00, Dev 45.00, Priya 45.00
Currency: EUR
Notes: team offsite travel 2026-03
```
Maya (People Ops): If a toll machine prints no receipt but you have a bank transaction or photo of the machine/ticket, attach both plus a short note (where/when). Amounts over $75 will need manager approval in the expense workflow.
Lina Chen: Got it — I'll upload photos of fuel receipts, bank lines for the tolls, and use the split template for the ferry. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: Thanks — saved the template. :handshake:
